title: Rust production SCHC ingress does not use bounded per-signer failure tracking
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: production RX in rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs and rpl_stack/receive.rs still calls raw lichen_schc::decompress. RuleVersionFailureTracker and decompress_tracked are exercised only by library tests, so actual malformed/version-mismatch traffic never gets signer-scoped streaks, exact-once notification, success reset, or fail-closed capacity. Integrate the bounded tracker into authenticated production ingress, exclude output-capacity errors, drop on tracker-full without eviction, and test multi-signer threshold/reset/capacity behavior through the node path.
